documents.title: Clarification sought from Oracle Financial Services Software Ltd
Intimation Of Grant Of Options Under OFSS Stock Plan 2014
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot

analysis.summary: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of 76.7 billion representing a 12 percent increase over the previous financial year, while net income rose to 26.4 billion reflecting an 11 percent increase year-on-year. The company maintained financial discipline with an operating margin of 44 percent and a net margin of 34 percent. Management noted that the business landscape was shaped by dynamic global developments, evolving geopolitical conditions, and accelerating technology trends like Artificial Intelligence and cloud computing. The Board approved two interim dividends totaling 400 per share for FY 2025-26 and appointed new board members while managing executive transitions. Oracle Financial Services Software reported a 7% increase in consolidated revenues to 68.5 billion and a 7% growth in net income to 23.8 billion for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.

demand_outlook.claim: The business landscape during the financial year was shaped by dynamic global developments, evolving geo-political conditions, and accelerating technology trends, creating a market environment that rewarded resilience and innovation.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape was shaped by dynamic global developments, evolving geo-political conditions, and accelerating technology trends, creating a market environment that rewarded resilience and innovation.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges, and shifting technology trends leading to demand challenges in the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: License & Cloud revenues grew 13% over financial year 2023-24, driven by an increasing demand for cloud-native banking solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: Driven by an increasing demand for our cloud-native banking solutions, our License & Cloud revenues grew 13% over financial year 2023-24.

demand_outlook.claim: Banks are under intense pressure to deliver digital delight at scale with compliance and lowest cost, increasingly looking at cloud-adaptable architecture.
demand_outlook.quote: With an increasingly tech savvy customer base which is spoilt for choice, banks are under intense pressure to deliver “digital delight” at scale with complete compliance to regulations and at the lowest possible cost.

margins_costs.claim: The net margin remained strong at 34 percent.
margins_costs.quote: Net income rose to ₹ 26.4 billion, reflecting an 11% increase year-on-year, while the net margin remained strong at 34%.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained strong financial discipline, resulting in an operating margin of 44 percent.
margins_costs.quote: We also continued to maintain strong financial discipline, resulting in an operating margin of 44%, reflecting the Company's consistent focus on execution and operational efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: The reported profit for the financial year 2025-26 is after considering the cost of employee stock compensation of 908 million using fair value method on Options or OSUs.
margins_costs.quote: The reported profit for the financial year 2025-26 is after considering the cost of employee stock compensation of ₹ 908 million using fair value method on Options / OSUs.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained strong financial discipline with operating margin for the financial year rising to 44% compared to 42% in the last financial year.
margins_costs.quote: We continued to maintain a strong financial discipline while driving the growth, and our operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% as compared to 42% in the last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained a track record of delivering consistent high profitability metrics among the best in the industry.
margins_costs.quote: It was also notable that we posted double digit growth across all the lines of business. We are proud that we have maintained a track record of delivering consistent high profitability metrics which are amongst the best in our industry.

orders_capacity.claim: The company signed multiple multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers worldwide.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company signed a number of multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers across the world which are a testimony to the excellence of our products through continuing R&D, our track record of delivering high quality implementations, and providing reliable support.

orders_capacity.claim: Fiscal year 2024 saw license wins of $137M, which is the highest ever for the company and registers a 44% growth over the last fiscal.
orders_capacity.quote: The fiscal year 2024 saw license wins of $137M – highest ever for the Company, registering a 44% growth over last fiscal.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling 400 per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for FY 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared a 1st interim dividend of 130 per equity share and a 2nd interim dividend of 270 per equity share of 5 each on October 17, 2025 and April 22, 2026, respectively, for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company ("the Board") declared 1st interim dividend of ₹ 130 per equity share and 2nd interim dividend of ₹ 270 per equity share of ₹ 5 each on October 17, 2025 and April 22, 2026, respectively, for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not transferred any amount to the reserves during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not transferred any amount to the reserves during the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: During the financial year 2025-26, the company has not accepted any deposits within the meaning of Sections 73 and 76 of the Act.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year 2025-26, the Company has not accepted any deposits within the meaning of Sections 73 and 76 of the Act, and as such, no amount of principal or interest on deposits was outstanding as of the date of the Balance Sheet.

capital_allocation.claim: During the financial year 2025-26, money realized was 45 million towards exercise of 171,198 Options or OSUs for fresh equity shares.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year 2025-26, money realized was ₹ 45 million towards exercise of 171,198 Options/OSUs for fresh equity shares.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved an interim dividend of 265 per share for the financial year 2024-25, which is 10.4% higher than the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board was pleased to approve an interim dividend of ₹ 265 per share for the financial year 2024-25, 10.4% higher than the dividend paid in the last financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared an interim dividend of 240 per share for the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: On the strength of the performance, the Board was pleased to declare an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per share for the financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The business landscape during the financial year was driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges, and shifting technology trends.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fiscal year 2024 was fraught with several uncertainties including geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, and bank failures in the western world.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fiscal year 2024 was fraught with several uncertainties including continued and expanding geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, highly visible failures of some banks in the western world, and tectonic technology shifts with increasing usage of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and machine learning (ML).

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
